description: Autopilot hooks. Tool-event hooks recover data from the session transcript (transcript-reader-lib) since the upstream stdin pipe is broken (#6305); see hooks/README.md. Opt-in hooks (hooks/opt-in-manifest.json) are wired here too but self-gate via hooks/_shared/opt-in.js — default-off, enabled per ~/.autopilot/config.json {"hooks":{"<stem>":true}}. _transcript-timing-probe.js is an opt-in diagnostic (not wired).

hooks.//: version-drift-check: dev-clone-only advisory (silent no-op for release/marketplace users). Wired here — NOT in settings.example.json — because ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} only expands inside the plugin's own hooks.json, never in a user's settings.json.

SessionEnd.//: session-handoff (writer): OPT-IN behaviour gated at runtime — no-ops unless handoff is enabled (env AUTOPILOT_HANDOFF_INJECT=1 OR ~/.autopilot/config.json {"handoff_inject":true}); the SAME switch enables the session-start reader/inject half. Wired here — NOT in settings.example.json — because ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} only expands inside the plugin's own hooks.json, never in a user's settings.json (so the old copy-into-settings.json instruction produced a literal unresolved path).

PreToolUse.//: OPT-IN (default-off, self-gated via _shared/opt-in.js): branch-protection + commit-secret-scan. Wired here so ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} resolves; inert until enabled in ~/.autopilot/config.json.
OPT-IN (default-off): dispatch-model-guard — ask on guarded expensive engine or omitted model

OPT-IN (default-off): orchestrator-edit-gate — in /l4-/l6 sessions (session-mode marker) depth-0 inline product edits are warned/denied; subagents pass (payload agent_id). A1 of the depth-0 economics plan (v2.32.26).

hooks.//: OPT-IN (default-off, self-gated): accumulator collects edited paths for batch-format
OPT-IN (default-off, self-gated): test-runner runs sibling tests
OPT-IN (default-off, self-gated): design-quality warns on generic UI patterns

PostToolUseFailure.//: OPT-IN (default-off): mcp-health marks a server unhealthy on MCP tool failure

Stop.//: OPT-IN (default-off, self-gated via _shared/opt-in.js): cost-tracker, session-summary, check-console, batch-format. Wired here so ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} resolves; inert until enabled in ~/.autopilot/config.json.
